text: every card you play ages you one year
you can only move when the music plays
your shadow fights on the enemy's side
the map redraws itself each time you blink
every friend you make becomes a weapon
gravity flips whenever someone tells a lie
you rewind ten seconds but the enemies remember
the dungeon is a single enormous sleeping creature
your inventory is a shared pet that gets hungry
every death permanently changes the town's weather
you play as the trap, not the hero
the boss only appears when you stop looking
silence is the only currency
all dialogue is delivered as haiku
your health bar is the time left on the sun
the only way to heal is to cook a proper meal
doors only open if you hum the right note
each level is the previous level seen from underwater
you swap bodies with the last thing you touched
every item you drop grows into a tree
the whole town can see everything you do
the floor is lava, but only on Tuesdays
you can undo any mistake, but not for free
the camera is a character who dislikes you
only one player can see the monsters
weapons are borrowed from your neighbours
the rain decides which paths exist
you carry a fragile candle through every fight
players take turns being the level
every jump costs a memory
